_about: Tool notes for tool management (MCP-21). Read by plan_tool_call (MCP-23, not built yet). Shape (user, 2026-11-13): family = the kind of tool; type = the jobs to use it for; antitype = the jobs it looks right for but must not be used for, each with the tool to use instead; limits = what goes wrong even on its own jobs. Evidence: persona bench of 2026-11-10/11 (Benchmark/audit/audit-1.html); case ids and scores as in mcp-upgrade/prd/tool-management/failures.md. Not yet confirmed by the user. best_settings: from the bench's recorded calls, settings compared within the same case (2026-11-13); free plan, 640px or 480p. Tier rule (user, 2026-11-13): free-tier models only. Image models' tiers are from docs/openapi.json; video models have no tier list there, so a video model counts as free when the free-tier bench used it.

families.image edit (redraws): A model redraws the user's picture. Nothing is kept exactly.
families.image by code: The user's picture is kept exactly; code cuts, reshapes or writes on it.
families.video edit (re-generates): A model re-generates the user's video. Nothing is kept exactly.
families.video by code: The user's video is kept exactly; code cuts, reshapes, writes on or joins it.
families.faces: A face or head from one picture onto a person in a photo or video.
families.sound: Music or voice, made as a sound file.
families.subtitles: Spoken words written on the video.
families.image make: A new picture from text, made by a model.
families.video make: A new video from text or from a picture, made by a model.
families.talking video: A person in a picture or video speaks given words.

edit_image.does: Redraws the whole picture from the user's picture and a prompt.
type: Change one object or the background: the car's colour, night for sunset, a beach behind a person (B07a/b/d, B09a-d: 3.3 to 4.7).
Remove an object or clutter (B08a-c: 3.3 to 4.0).
A style: film look, anime, black and white (B10a-c: 4.0 to 4.7).
The same character or product in new scenes (C16a/b: 4.0).

antitype.why: It keeps the input's shape: a wide photo asked to be square came back 640x384 (B12a-d: 1.0 to 1.3).

antitype.job: Exact words, a caption, a meme
antitype.why: Letters are misspelt or moved (B11a 2.3, J49b 2.3).
Both pictures are redrawn and cropped (G35a/b: 1.7 to 2.0).
Small details change too (B07c, J49a). Close enough for black and white (B10c 4.7).

limits: Parts that should stay can change slightly, because the whole picture is redrawn.
edit_image.deciding_question: Should the picture be redrawn, or kept exactly and only reshaped, cut or written on?
edit_image.bench: Right tool: 158 runs, average 3.6. Wrong tool: 129 runs, average 2.6.

best_settings.evidence: Same case: qwen-edit beat flux-2-klein in 15 of 19 cases (3.15 vs 2.58); qwen-image-2.1 beat qwen-edit 6 of 9 (3.74 vs 3.21) and flux-2-klein 3 of 4 (3.54 vs 2.25). flux-2-klein also ignores aspect_ratio (4:5 asked: 2.0; 9:16: 1.8), qwen follows it (4:5: 3.6).
best_settings.conflict: The upstream description of edit_image (openapi_policies.py, #179) suggests flux-2-klein for a Free account. plan_tool_call's output must name the model.
best_settings.tier: free (all models named here are free-tier)

edit_video.does: Re-generates the whole video from the user's video and a prompt.
type: Change how the whole video looks, when the user accepts that it is re-made. Not shown in the bench: it was never the right tool in 36 runs.

antitype.why: Output is about 832x448 or 832x512 whatever was asked (E25a/b: 1.0).

antitype.job: A shorter clip, the best part, cut the boring parts
antitype.why: It re-renders the footage instead of cutting it (E26a/b: 2.0).
The mark was missing (E29c: 1.0).

limits: Output shape is its own (about 832x512), not the input's (J49c).
edit_video.deciding_question: Should the video be re-made, or kept and only cut, reshaped or written on?

generate_music.does: Makes a music track from a style prompt. Sound only.
type: A music bed of 15 s or more (F30b/c: 4.0).

antitype.why: The API's minimum duration is 15 s: a 10 s request came back 15 s (F30a 2.3; E27a, E27c).
It makes a separate file; nothing puts it on the video (E27a-c: 2.0).

generate_music.deciding_question: How long, and on its own or under the user's video?

add_subtitles_to_video.does: Transcribes the speech in the video and burns it in as subtitles.
type: Subtitles in the language that is spoken (E24a: 3.0).

antitype.why: It writes the spoken language: Spanish asked, English delivered (E24b: 2.0).
It has no shape setting (E24d, E25c).

antitype.use: no call: tell the user there is no speech
antitype.why: The job fails instead of saying so (E24c).

limits: The first line is sometimes missing (E24a).
add_subtitles_to_video.deciding_question: Same language as the speech, or translated? Does the clip have speech?

best_settings.evidence: highlight 2.79 (14 runs), minimalist 2.47, cinematic 2.42. No same-case comparison; weak.

swap_head_in_photo.does: Puts the whole head from one picture (face, hair, head shape) onto the body in another picture. 10 credits.
swap_head_in_photo.preferred: User, 2026-11-13: use head swap for swapping faces in photos.
type: Put the user's face on someone in a photo, keeping their hair and head shape so they are recognisable (C14a).

antitype.job: A face swap in a video
antitype.why: Head swap is photo only.

antitype.job: One chosen person in a group photo, if head swap picks the wrong one
antitype.why: Its only settings are body_file_path and head_file_path: no face choice (C14b, not tested).

limits: Not benchmarked: never called in the persona bench. Test on C14a and C14b.
swap_head_in_photo.deciding_question: Which picture gives the head, and which picture (and which person) receives it?

swap_face_in_photo.does: Puts a face from one picture onto faces in another picture. The face only, not hair or head shape.
type: Several people in one photo, each with their own new face (individual-faces mode, after detect_faces).

antitype.job: A face swap on one person
antitype.why: Only the face changes; hair and head shape stay, so the person is less recognisable (C14b 2.0 to 2.3).

swap_face_in_photo.deciding_question: One person, or several people each with their own new face?

best_settings.evidence: all-faces 3.86 (7 runs), individual-faces 2.00 (5 runs, all on C14b, the hard case). Not a fair comparison.

swap_face_in_video.does: Puts a face from a picture onto a person in a video.
type: One person in a short clip; motion and framing are kept.

antitype.why: Asked for the first 5 s, it delivered all 10 s (C15a).

antitype.job: A face swap in a photo
antitype.why: User's choice for photos.

limits: The new face is a blend; graders did not recognise the portrait (C15a 2.7). Warn the user. No head swap exists for video.
Two faces in one clip: both barely change and the sound was lost (C15c: 1.0 to 1.3).
swap_face_in_video.deciding_question: Which person, and which part of the clip?

remove_image_background.does: Cuts the subject out of a picture onto a transparent background.
type: A product or person with clear edges.

antitype.use: remove the background from the logo without words, then add_words_to_media (MCP-25)
antitype.why: The letters fade or smear (A06c: 2.7).
It only makes the PNG; nothing puts it on the video (E29a: 1.3).

remove_image_background.deciding_question: Is there text in the picture? Where will the cut-out be used?
remove_image_background.bench: Right tool: 9 runs, average 1.6 (most of it E29a, a job no tool finishes).

reframe_media.does: Changes the shape of a picture or video by code: crop, pad (bars of one colour), fill (over a blurred copy) or auto. 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1. 0 credits.
type: A new shape for the user's picture or video, nothing redrawn (B12a/b/d, E25a, J50a, J51b).
After a tool that keeps its own shape: edit_image, edit_video, create_video_from_image, add_subtitles_to_video (MCP-26).

antitype.why: Its shapes are 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 (B12c, A03, G34b).

antitype.job: Two people who take turns, each centred
antitype.use: trim_media per speaker, reframe_media each with its own focus, join_videos (MCP-27)
antitype.why: One focus per call (E25b).

limits: Not benchmarked: added in cbbe722, after the bench.
Crop loses the edges: set `focus` on the subject (B12d, the shoe on the left), or use pad or fill to keep everything.
reframe_media.deciding_question: Crop (lose the edges), or keep everything with bars (pad) or a blurred copy (fill)? Where is the subject?

trim_media.does: Cuts a video or sound file from `start` to `end` seconds by code. Picture and sound kept. 0 credits.
type: Shorten the user's clip, keep the first N seconds, cut a clip into parts (E26a/b, J49c, J50b).
Music under 15 s: after generate_music (MCP-28).
A frame at a chosen time: trim to it, then get_last_frame (G33b).
Only part of a clip for a face swap: trim first (C15a).

antitype.use: none: it cuts video and sound only
antitype.why: Pictures are refused.

limits: Not benchmarked: added in cbbe722, after the bench.
It does not choose the part: 'the best 10 seconds' needs a look at the clip first (E26a, MCP-07).
trim_media.deciding_question: Which part, from when to when?

add_words_to_media.does: Draws exact words on a picture or video by code: title, caption, price, name, watermark. Always spelled right. 0 credits.
type: Exact words on a picture: headline, flyer text, a logo's name, a meme (A02, A03, A06a/b, B11a/c/d, G33, G34, G39a, J49b).
A watermark or caption on a video, for the whole clip or from start to end (E29c).
After making the picture without words (MCP-25).

antitype.job: Words that must look printed on an object (a sign, a label)
antitype.use: edit_image, or make the object plain, then add the words here and tell the user
antitype.why: Drawn words sit on top; they do not follow the object (B11b, A01d).

antitype.job: A logo picture on a video
antitype.why: It draws words, not pictures (E29a).

limits: Not benchmarked: added in cbbe722, after the bench.
Places: top, middle, bottom, corners. Sizes: small, normal, large. No free position or font choice.
add_words_to_media.deciding_question: The exact words, where, and how big? On an object, or over the picture?

mix_audio.does: Lays sound files over each other into one sound file: a voice over music, a podcast intro. Sound only. 0 credits.
type: A voice over music, music first then the voice (F32a, MCP-28).

antitype.why: It outputs sound only, no picture (E27, E28).

limits: Not benchmarked: added in cbbe722, after the bench.
mix_audio.deciding_question: Which tracks, from when, and how loud?

join_videos.does: Joins videos end to end with hard cuts, or sound files into one sound file. 0 credits.
type: Several clips into one film (E25b, J50b, C15a).
Voice lines made one at a time into one sound file (F31b, F32b).

antitype.why: Called on one clip for no reason in 24 runs (average 2.0).
It refuses a mix of video and sound files.

limits: Every clip is fitted to the first one's size.
join_videos.deciding_question: Which clips, in what order, with sound or silent?
join_videos.bench: Right tool: 1 run. Wrong tool: 24 runs, average 2.0.

get_last_frame.does: Takes the last frame of a video as a picture. 0 credits.
type: Continue a clip: the last frame becomes the start of create_video_from_image (J50b).
A frame at a chosen time: trim_media to it first (G33b).

antitype.job: Seeing what is in the video
antitype.use: none: one frame shows only the end
antitype.why: Used to 'look' at clips in 12 runs (average 1.9).

get_last_frame.deciding_question: Is the end of the clip what is needed?
get_last_frame.bench: Right tool: 3 runs. Wrong tool: 12 runs, average 1.9.

detect_faces.does: Finds the faces in a picture or video, for a swap that maps each face.
type: Before swap_face_in_photo or swap_face_in_video in individual-faces mode, when several people each get their own face.

antitype.job: Any job that is not a per-face swap
antitype.why: Called as an extra step in 30 runs (average 1.9); its face crops were delivered as results (C14b, G33b).

detect_faces.deciding_question: Do several people each get a different face?
detect_faces.bench: Right tool: 5 runs, average 2.0. Wrong tool: 30 runs, average 1.9.

generate_image.does: Makes pictures from text. Shapes 1:1, 16:9, 9:16. Many models.
type: Product shots, illustrations, scenes (A01, A04: 3.3 to 4.5).
Pictures without words, then add_words_to_media for exact words (MCP-25).

antitype.why: Headlines misspelt or changed: 'CEAN UP YOUR BACH' (A02b), 'Fresh Green Arrivals' for 'Bring home some green' (A02c), a logo name wrong (A06b 2.7).

limits: Shapes: only 1:1, 16:9, 9:16 in the aspect setting; 4:5 needs another step.
Exact counts and colours drift: about 25 balloons for 3 (A04c), clear glass for amber (A01d).
A vague user's details get lost: a silver bottle on white for 'matte black on marble' (A01a); ask, do not guess.
generate_image.deciding_question: Are there exact words? Exact counts or colours that must be right? What shape?

use.style.tool: ai-illustration-generator for an illustration, else none

best_settings.evidence: Same case: qwen-image-2.1 beat flux-2-klein in 11 of 14 cases (3.24 vs 2.43) and z-image-turbo 6 of 8 (3.37 vs 2.45). style.tool ai-illustration-generator beat none 8 of 8 (3.57 vs 2.74); ai-photo-generator lost to none 5 of 5 (2.60 vs 3.20); movie-poster-generator lost 2 of 2.
best_settings.tier: free (all models named here are free-tier)

create_video_from_text.does: Makes a video from text. 1 to 60 s; 16:9, 9:16, 1:1.
type: A short clip of a scene (J49c 3.2).

antitype.why: It makes a new video, nothing of the user's is kept.

antitype.job: A label or exact words in the video
antitype.why: Labels missing (I46b).

limits: Motion of objects can be wrong: the frisbee passes through the dog (D19a).
Most of its runs are video composition items; for single clips the bench has few cases.
create_video_from_text.deciding_question: How long, what shape, with sound or silent?

best_settings.evidence: Same case: ltx-2.5 beat default in 11 of 16 cases (2.24 vs 1.97). minimax-h3: 23 runs, 2.52, no same-case comparison.
best_settings.tier: free (all models named here are free-tier)

create_video_from_image.does: Animates a picture into a video. 1 to 60 s. Keeps the picture's shape.
type: Bring a picture to life (C17a/b 4.0, G37 reels 3.0 to 3.3).
Continue a clip from its last frame (J50b).

antitype.why: It adds motion and the card came out 2 s instead of 9 (E29b).

limits: The motion asked for may not happen: a push-in zoom for a quarter turn of the bottle (D18a).
No shape setting: reframe_media after if a shape was asked.
create_video_from_image.deciding_question: What should move, and how long?

upscale_image.does: Enlarges a picture. Modes: pro, preserve, balanced, creative.
type: Make a sharp picture bigger (B13c 4.8).

antitype.job: Restore an old photo, keep the faces
antitype.use: test edit_image first; use mode preserve
antitype.why: Faces were regenerated with broader smiles and different features (B13a 2.0).

limits: Scale is a factor (2x): a 640 px long edge is not hit exactly (B13b: 480x480).
A very blurry photo is only slightly cleaner (B13b 2.0).
upscale_image.deciding_question: Bigger only, or also fixed? How big?

best_settings.evidence: preserve: 20 runs, 3.10; balanced: 2 runs, 2.0. No same-case comparison; weak.

generate_headshot.does: Makes a professional headshot from a photo of a person.
type: A professional headshot (A05b 4.0).

antitype.job: A square headshot or a set background
antitype.why: It returned 928x1152 portrait, framed to the waist, and an office background for 'plain grey' (A05a 3.0).

limits: No shape or background setting.
generate_headshot.deciding_question: Shape and background, or the tool's own?

create_meme.does: Makes a meme from a topic on a known template.
type: A meme about a topic, the template chosen by the tool (G39b 3.5).

antitype.job: A meme with the user's own picture and exact words
antitype.why: It uses its templates and writes its own caption.

limits: Captions can break mid-word or overflow the panel, and drift off the topic (G39b: a weekend joke for 'Mondays').
create_meme.deciding_question: The user's picture and words, or a template and a joke on a topic?

create_talking_photo.does: Makes a photo of a person speak given words.
type: A photo of the user saying a line (C17a/b 4.0).

antitype.why: It keeps the photo's shape: 1024x1536 for 'square' (C17a/b).

limits: Resolution 480p or 720p.
create_talking_photo.deciding_question: The exact line, and the shape?

create_spoken_ad_video.does: Makes a short ad video of a person speaking (UGC ad). Models kling-3.0, ltx-2.5, veo3.1.
type: A talking ad from a picture and a line (C17b 4.0, H43a 4.0).
limits: Length: 5 s came back for 8 s asked (C17a/b); check the length setting.

create_lip_sync_video.does: Makes a person in a video mouth a given audio track.
type: The person on screen says new words (an on-screen presenter).

antitype.job: A voice-over with no presenter, or the original footage kept as it is
antitype.why: It re-made the footage at 832x448, details changed (E28a); black clips and burned-in captions (E28c 1.7).

limits: Few runs (5).
create_lip_sync_video.deciding_question: Is a person on screen who should speak the words?

free_models._resolution: Free plan: 640px for pictures, 480p for video in the bench.
